scope: Frontend harness repair; fixtures only; PR CI required

checks.name: Demo tabs, keyboard focus, bounded contract diagnostics and safe input
Conditional recheck preserves generation and exposes 304
Failed/malformed refresh retains content and recovers
Initial 304, HTTP and network errors have no stale data
Mismatched ETag is an observation
Persistent divergence pauses hidden and clears on convergence
Transient revisions converge without persistent warning
Capability downgrade suppresses subsequent Work reads
Retired held response cannot reappear in a new project
Unknown strings remain raw warnings
Graph navigation and reload retain replay context
Hostile display and phone panel are safe under CSP
Normal production excludes lab and works with storage blocked
Canceled departure preserves focus refresh; pagehide suspends and persisted pageshow restores it
Ordinary polling pauses hidden and immediately revalidates on visibility restoration
Large worlds stay bounded; baseline comparison recorded
Work workspace preserves results while Why uses no extra reads
Bounded supplied graph, edge sources, list switch and fit pan
Runs pilot, legacy routes and copied URL reload
Modal inspector keyboard focus, Escape and phone overflow
Concealed phone detail stops polling; revealing immediately revalidates
Malformed IDs and unsupported history do not fall back to current reads
History provenance routes and unsupported historical claims stay explicit
History moved-to hot parent resolves through Work and opens its workspace
CSP hostile content, clipboard failure and dataset-switch cleanup
Production access refusal removes cached detail and its inspector
